desc: a casket creeper: an ornate dark iron-banded coffin with glowing green trim and chains, carried on eight pale bony spider legs, a small skull-faced head peeking from one end. The coffin body stays rigid and level in every frame; only the legs move
defect: legs cut off mid-air and the coffin drawn 30% smaller than it should be
extra: Draw the coffin LARGE -- it fills most of each figure's height, exactly as big as reference 1 shows it.
